name: Sarsha Tanner
headline: Enterprise Delivery Leader | Strategy → Execution | Technology, Governance & Large-Scale Delivery | Currently Head of Delivery Execution @Kmart Australia
about:
I specialise in turning strategy into execution inside complex organisations. My career has been built at the intersection of technology, operations and business transformation, aligning stakeholders, strengthening governance and bringing clarity to complex environments.

What I’m known for:
• Connecting strategy to practical execution
• Bringing structure and accountability to complex programs
• Aligning cross-functional teams around clear outcomes
• Turning ambitious ideas into disciplined delivery

I’ve spent my career in high-scale retail and consumer environments, including leadership roles across technology delivery, store development and enterprise transformation.

I thrive in environments that combine strong commercial ambition with meaningful impact, where innovation, operational maturity and culture evolve together.
